Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
 Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures D/63 BA1 No.993 of 2025  With  Time Extension Application (IA) No.5 of 2025  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. B.M. Molekhi, AGA for the State.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the informant.
The applicant is in judicial custody in FIR No.485 of 2024, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 471 and 120-B IPC, Police Station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
On 21.07.2025, the applicant was granted interim bail on the ground that main accused has already been granted short term bail by this Court.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the interim bail time has already expired,
therefore, the applicant has already surrendered before the court.
He would submit that the main accused has been granted short term bail till 06.10.2025, so that he may settle the dispute with the informant bank.
Learned counsel for the informant Bank admits this fact, but he would submit that the applicant shall also join the settlement proceeding with the Bank.

Having considered, this Court is of the view that since the co-accused have been extended interim bail till 06.10.2025, the applicant may be granted interim bail till 06.10.2025, so as to settle the dispute with the Bank.
Let the applicant be released on interim bail upto 06.10.2025, on his executing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/-.
It is further directed that, on expiry of the period of interim bail, the applicant shall surrender before the court concerned and intimation to that effect shall also be given to this Court.
The applicant shall deposit his passport, if any, to the court concerned.

List on 10.10.2025.
